{{Unknown name}} [[File:McKenzie father.png|thumb|250px|McKenzie's father]] '''McKenzie's father''' (Japanese: '''イサミの父''' ''Isami's father'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP201|Doin' What Comes Natu-rally]]''. He doesn't have an official name in the original version or the dub. He is world-famous for being a street performer in the Pokémon Street Performer Festival. He would use his {{p|Natu}} in order to read people's futures. When his son [[McKenzie]] wanted to be like him and help him perform, he told him he was up for anything that pleases the audience. He commended {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} for having McKenzie perform while wearing a mask to hide his face. He holds the belief that experience teaches both people and Pokémon how to grow. {{-}} ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|2|enva|java}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=McKenzie's father |pkmn=Natu |type1=Psychic |type2=Flying |img=McKenzie father Natu.png |epnum=EP201 |epname=Doin' What Comes Natu-rally |desc=McKenzie's father has a {{p|Natu}} which is able to tell people's fortunes with its Future Sight. It did this trick at a fair. It works as follows: Natu is given a token, then the Natu goes over to a pool of water and dips its wings in it; flies and hops across three rocks in a triangle; then heads over to a bell hanging over a box. The Natu rings the bell, slips the token in the box, and uses Future Sight to draw out a fortune. Later, {{TRT}} came to the fair and captured Natu with loads of other Pokémon. Eventually, [[Ash's Bayleef]] cut Team Rocket's net and freed them. Natu's only known move is {{m|Future Sight}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{flying color light}} |ja=小西克幸 ''[[Katsuyuki Konishi]]'' |en=[[Dan Green]] |ar=حسن حمدان ''Hasan Hamdan'' |cs=Jiří Prager |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |it=Gianluca Iacono |pt_br=Figueira Júnior |es_la=Martín Soto |es_eu=Eduardo Bosch |pl=Wojciech Majchrzak}}
